<translate>
DragonMineZ adds its own items on top of vanilla Minecraft: healing beans, Dragon Ball radars, scouters, vehicles, stat capsules, relics and crafting materials. This page groups them by family; each row links the page that covers the item or the whole family in detail.

Armor, special weapons, enchantments and training gear have their own pages, listed at the end.
</translate>

<translate>
== Dragon Ball tools ==
</translate>
{{See also|Dragons and Wishes}}
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Page</translate> !! <translate>Includes</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Dragon Radar}} || <translate>Dragon Radar (Earth), Dragon Radar (Namek), Bi-Dimensional Radar, Radar's Piece, Radar's Chips and Radar's CPUs</translate> || <translate>Shows the Dragon Balls of its world on screen. The Bi-Dimensional Radar works on Earth and Namek. The chips and CPUs are also used in many other recipes.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Transport ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Page</translate> !! <translate>Includes</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Flying Nimbus}} || <translate>Flying Nimbus, Black Nimbus</translate> || <translate>A fast rideable cloud from Korin. Only the pure of heart can ride the Flying Nimbus; the Black Nimbus only carries evil hearts.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Space Pod}} || <translate>Saiyan Space Pod</translate> || <translate>A one-person spacecraft that takes you between worlds: Earth, Namek, the Otherworld, the Sacred Kai Planet, the Time Chamber and the Demon Realm.</translate>

<translate>
== Scouters and stealth ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Page</translate> !! <translate>Includes</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Scouters}} || <translate>Scouter (Red), Scouter (Blue), Scouter (Green), Scouter (Purple)</translate> || <translate>Read the Battle Power of the entity you look at and point to the strongest one nearby.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Anti-Ki Cloaking Device}} || — || <translate>Hides your Battle Power from scouters, Ki Sense, Instant Transmission and party markers.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Healing and consumables ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Page</translate> !! <translate>Includes</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| {{L|Senzu Bean}} || <translate>Senzu Bean, Senzu Bean (Health), Senzu Bean (Ki), Senzu Bean (Stamina), Senzu Bean Seeds</translate> || <translate>Fully restores health, ki and stamina. The colored beans restore only one resource each and can be farmed.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Senzu Bag}} || — || <translate>Carries up to 64 Senzu Beans of any color in one slot and lets you eat them straight from the bag.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Heart Medicine}} || — || <translate>Restores health, ki and stamina like a Senzu Bean. Brewed from a Senzu Bean.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Medi-Bugs}} || <translate>Medi-Bug (Ant), Medi-Bug (Rhino), Medi-Bug (Worm), Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate>Demon Realm bugs that heal, harden your body, boost mastery gain or let two players fuse.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Fruit of the Tree of Might}} || — || <translate>A temporary power boost (the Might Fruit effect).</translate>
|-
| {{L|Ki Battery}} || — || <translate>Restores 50% of your max ki.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Food}} || <translate>Dino Meat, Baby Dino Meat, Dino Tail, Frog Legs, Giant Fish, Giant Turtle</translate> || <translate>DMZ's own foods. Eating any food also restores a share of your health, ki and stamina.</translate>
|-
| {{L|Golden Carrot}} || — || <translate>The vanilla golden carrot, which DMZ asks for in quests and hands out as a raid reward.</translate>
|}

<translate>
All Senzu Beans share one cooldown, so you can't chain one of each color. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bean#Cooldown|Senzu Bean]].
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Page</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>

== Other items ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Item</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| '''<translate>Blaster Cannon</translate>''' || <translate>Fires a ki blast when you right-click it (3-second cooldown) and wears out after 200 shots. They lead to DMZ structures and world boss lairs (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]).</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Curios slots ==

Several DMZ items are worn in Curios slots instead of armor slots:

* '''Head Tech''' slot: [[Special:MyLanguage/Scouters|scouters]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Anti-Ki Cloaking Device|Anti-Ki Cloaking Device]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Potara Earrings|Potara earrings]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Eye|Demon Eye]].
* '''Weights''' slot: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|weights]].

Scouters, Potara earrings and weights also work in the cosmetic Curios slots.
</translate>
